live_paper_trades.note: Written by the live watcher (scripts/tg_alerts.py --watch) through PaperTradeEngine.create_paper_trade. This is the population the production code itself treats as genuine ('_is_live').

test_fixture_trades.role: EXCLUDED - historical test fixtures / research re-runs
test_fixture_trades.note: The production code (app/paper_trade/performance.py, engine.py) excludes rows without origin='live-watch' and reports them as excluded_test_records. Their own price/label semantics are internally inconsistent (see DATA_QUALITY_AND_RECONCILIATION.md).

engine_signal_book.role: LIVE-ENGINE SIGNAL BOOK WITH MODELLED (opens-execution) OUTCOMES
engine_signal_book.note: The approved-spec opens-execution book that drives paper.html and signals, refreshed by the running service up to the latest session (app/research/cpr_trigger_engine.exits_opens, stop 0.5% / target 2%, STOP-first). Outcomes are modelled from index candle opens, so these are SIMULATED executions of real live-engine signals, not fills.

engine_signal_book_vix.role: EXCLUDED - INDIA_VIX is not traded or alerted
engine_signal_book_vix.note: scripts/shadow_friday.py states INDIA_VIX is not traded or alerted (tg_alerts watches NIFTY/BANKNIFTY only).

legacy_journal.note: scripts/shadow_friday.py: the old trade_journal source has had no production writer since the Phase-9 backend was removed and was stale at its last session. Reported for context only, never mixed with the live populations.

vetoed_signals.role: EXCLUDED - signals vetoed before an entry existed
vetoed_signals.note: No entry, therefore not a trade.

live_observations.note: Decision log; most rows are MARKET_CLOSED/WEEKEND observations.

qualified_trades.role: EXCLUDED - qualification records without a recorded outcome
qualified_trades.note: Signal qualification ledger; no exit price or outcome.

trade_mistake.filter: all rows (joined to the legacy journal)
trade_mistake.role: REFERENCE - the engine-side mistake labels of the legacy journal
